svg.text: Dynamic comparator - actual MOS connections and isolated latch
11 direct MOS + 4 CMOS inverters (8 MOS) + 2 NAND2 gates (8 MOS) = 27 expanded MOS
Named gates/nodes are electrically connected wherever the same name appears.
All gates clk; all sources/bulks vdd.
clk=1: M7 evaluates; precharge turns OFF.
ip > in should resolve x LOW, y HIGH -> q=1.
Two identical inverters per side isolate the regenerative nodes from SR-latch history.
L=30 nm throughout. NMOS bulks=vss; PMOS bulks=vdd. Each inverter Wn/Wp=0.5/1 um.
MOS terminal mapping is checked against generator output. This is an engineering netlist diagram, not an OA schematic or layout.
